#region 🔖️EnsureBun
install_pinned_bun() {
  local version="$1" platform arch musl=false row pinned release archive sha download
  platform="$(host_platform)" || return 1
  arch="$(host_arch)" || return 1
  if host_is_musl; then musl=true; fi
  row="$(bun_release_row "$platform" "$arch" "$musl")"
  if [ -z "$row" ]; then
    log "No pinned Bun distribution for $platform/$arch (musl=$musl) in $BUN_PINS_FILE."
    return 1
  fi
  read -r pinned release archive sha <<<"$row"
  [ "$pinned" = "$version" ] || {
    log "The Bun pin $pinned in $BUN_PINS_FILE differs from package.json packageManager bun@$version; update both."
    return 1
  }
  download="$(mktemp -d)"
  download_verified "$release/$archive" "$sha" "$download/$archive" || {
    rm -rf "$download"
    return 1
  }
  mkdir -p "$BUN_INSTALL/bin"
  unzip -p "$download/$archive" "${archive%.zip}/bun" >"$download/bun" && chmod 755 "$download/bun" && mv -f "$download/bun" "$BUN_INSTALL/bin/bun" || {
    rm -rf "$download"
    return 1
  }
  rm -rf "$download"
}

ensure_bun() {
  local package_manager
  package_manager="$(awk -F'"' '/"packageManager"[[:space:]]*:/ { print $4; exit }' "$REPO_ROOT/package.json")"
  if ! printf '%s\n' "$package_manager" | grep -Eq '^bun@[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$'; then
    log "package.json must declare an exact packageManager bun@x.y.z before native setup."
    return 1
  fi
  local required_version="${package_manager#bun@}"
  local actual_version
  actual_version="$(bun --version 2>/dev/null || true)"
  export BUN_INSTALL="${BUN_INSTALL:-$HOME/.bun}"
  export PATH="${BUN_INSTALL}/bin:${PATH}"
  if [ "$actual_version" != "$required_version" ]; then
    log "Installing repository-pinned Bun $required_version…"
    install_pinned_bun "$required_version" || return 1
    hash -r
    actual_version="$(bun --version 2>/dev/null || true)"
  fi
  if [ "$actual_version" != "$required_version" ]; then
    log "Bun toolchain mismatch: package.json requires $required_version, but native setup resolved ${actual_version:-missing}. Install bun-v$required_version and rerun setup."
    return 1
  fi
}
#endregion 🔖️EnsureBun

Feature: One Native Repository Entrypoint
  Scenario: Build commands preserve their complete argument tail
    Given the shared native entrypoint vectors
    When each native implementation selects a route
    Then build commands enter the owned build script unchanged
    And only explicit mcp selects stdio protocol
    And dashboard expands to its authored native run target
    And domain commands retain their original arguments

  Scenario: OS MCP keeps protocol stdout quiet
    Given the explicit native dev mcp stdio os route
    When its existing workspace script owner serves the protocol
    Then its exact arguments and Original environment are retained
    And progress remains on stderr
    And stdout contains only the existing MCP protocol

  Scenario: A script runs through the provisioned runtime
    Given an argument vector that names a script file, optionally led by the neutral watch and cwd options
    When the launcher plans the route
    Then the script route keeps every argument unchanged
    And the neutral options map to the flags of the selected runtime
    And no runtime has to be installed because the launcher provisions the pinned one
